page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; a catchword at the lower right; a small mark at the bottom centre. No margin notes.

main_text.p: 2. ω. Ἡφαιστος Vulçanus, Ἡφαιστίων nomen proprium.
μωρὸς fatuus, μωρίων morio. Quidam etiam dicunt
κερδαλέα vulpes, κερδῶν vulpecula. Alii verò per ω,
Dupliciter diminuta. Quædam bis diminuuntur, ut
ὀλον pulpamentum, ὀλαίον pulpamentulum, ὀλαείδιον pulpamentillum.
ῥῆμα verbum, ῥημάτιον verbulum, ῥη-ματίσκιον verbululum.

page.notes: Greek words are transcribed approximately; the Greek type is small and partly worn, so accents and some letters are doubtful. The word "ἰμά-" at lower right is a catchword. The mark "ɺ" at the bottom centre is a small printed sign, not transcribed.
